title: promoteChange
responsibility: Validates a scoped Change against a clean configured source branch and every required lower target.

inputs.name: prepareChangeEnvironment.session
inputs.description: Project session used to identify the active source repository and configured branch.

inputs.name: prepareChangeEnvironment.request
inputs.description: Run mode and optional selected environment; unscoped or read-only requests do not promote.

inputs.name: promoteChange.context
inputs.description: Repository-locked run context with source revision, cancellation signal and status emitter.

inputs.name: promoteChange.before
inputs.description: Source snapshot taken before the agent writes; only observed changes are staged.

outputs.name: prepareChangeEnvironment
outputs.description: Resolves when admission is safe or the request is unscoped; rejects invalid mappings or source state.

outputs.name: promoteChange
outputs.description: Public summary naming the queued lower boundary and the separate production action when needed.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects unsafe source, target or promotion state; no successful deployment receipt is recorded.
